title: Italian Roasted Carrot Quesadilla
description: A unique Italian twist on the classic quesadilla, featuring roasted carrots, perfect for a quick meal.
instructions: Peel and chop the carrot into 1-inch pieces.
Toss the carrot with olive oil, salt, pepper, and minced garlic on a baking sheet.
Roast the carrot in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the carrot is roasting, heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
Fold the quesadilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Cut the quesadilla into wedges and top with roasted carrot, parsley, and additional parmesan cheese if desired.
